title: nwc → ssc erasure command
description: The signed OP→RP right-to-be-forgotten command nwc (provider, nwc_moodle_erase) sends to the Moodle consumer (local_nwc_erase). DESTRUCTIVE, single-writer, idempotent on request_id. additionalProperties:false is the data-minimisation + tamper gate (P74 Phase-0 / NWP-ADR-0031). `sub` is the UUID identity anchor (= the OIDC sub = Drupal user.uuid()); the receiver resolves the Moodle row by idnumber==sub and NEVER by email. Changing this shape is a boundary change → contract_version bump + ss-side review. ops#81.

sub.description: Subject = the provider OIDC sub = Drupal user.uuid(). The UID-lock join key → mdl_user.idnumber. Resolve-by-idnumber only; never by email.

request_id.description: Unique id for this erasure request. The receiver is idempotent on this — a replay is a no-op, never a second delete.

action.description: delete = full Privacy-API delete (tool_dataprivacy); anonymise = de-identify but retain de-identified aggregates.

issuer.description: The provider issuer URL; must match the configured trusted issuer on the consumer.

timestamp.description: Seconds since epoch when the command was issued (integer, not a date string).
